description: Custom-error selectors the Fyuz contract can revert a swap with, and how each SDK must surface them. An eth_call that reverts returns the 4-byte selector as its revert data; without this table a caller sees an opaque `0xcfa6d878` and has no idea the token graduated. Selectors computed with `cast sig` from foundry/src/Fyuz.sol.
note: These are NOT in the ABI served by GET /config — that response only carries the OpenZeppelin errors. The table is the only place the mapping exists, which is why all four SDKs read it from here.

revertible.message: The token graduated: the bonding curve is closed and every swap entrypoint reverts. Trade the PancakeSwap pair instead.
No bonding curve exists for this token on this chain — check the address and the network.
The price moved past minAmountOut before the transaction landed. Re-quote and retry, or widen the slippage tolerance.
The deadline passed before the transaction was mined. Rebuild with a later deadline.
The trade would move the curve further than the contract allows. Split it into smaller trades.
The sell exceeds MAX_SELL_PERCENT of the virtual token reserve. Sell less, or in several transactions.
msg.value was below buyAmount + getFirstBuyFee(token). The fee is not optional and is not deducted from buyAmount.
The wallet does not hold enough of the token to cover this sell.
The input amount rounds down to zero output on the curve. Trade a larger amount.
The curve does not hold enough of the other side to fill this trade.
The amount must be greater than zero.
The BNB/USD feed is stale or unavailable, so the contract cannot price this call.
Trading is paused on the contract.

standard.note: The classic require(msg) revert. The reason is an ABI-encoded string starting 4 bytes in: offset word, length word, then the UTF-8 bytes.
A compiler-inserted assertion: 0x11 is arithmetic overflow, 0x12 division by zero. Reaching one of these from a swap is a contract bug, not a caller error.

decode_cases.name: unknown_selector
decode_cases.note: An unrecognised selector is reported verbatim rather than swallowed — a future contract version will add errors this table does not know.

decode_cases.name: empty
decode_cases.note: Some RPC providers strip revert data entirely. The SDK must not crash trying to read a selector out of an empty string.
